admission.justification: Future changes to task-page reads, conditional transport, native generation capture or retained-content ownership must prevent stale or unbounded cache reuse and a counter failure blocking the document. Named current source assertions guard the specified facets; historical timing/count samples remain task-local, not enduring obligations or fresh Curator grades.

applicability: Retained landed/working change-set lists, counters and file contents within the app-owned native read context.
conditions: A commit-pair change set is keyed by its two object ids and served again with no observation on a hit; object loss and working-tree attribute/configuration changes are the named accepted gap until eviction or restart.
A working view has no cache where a plain Git read costs no more than its freshness check; its list is computed by Git on every read, and the exact counter tuple may be reused.
A working status Git cannot compute is unknown, not unchanged: only a refusal may be kept on it, never a successful result.
Missing, unreadable, racing or evicted observations do not authorize reuse; a restored missing object revokes an earlier absence proof.
exclusions: No independent Git diff/parser or second task-stage authority.
No zero-Git guarantee for a working view or for a cold/mutated/refused read.
